name: Representatives
description: One continuous identity for each AI representative, whether it stands for a real person or is a character of its own: who it is, the authority it holds and whose data it may read, carried into every request and its sub-goals.
purpose: Let each representative act as itself over time: as the person it stands for would want, within the authority that person gave, or as the character it is when no person stands behind it.
approach: Resolve who the representative is and what it may do before work starts, and pass that identity to every part that remembers, recalls, asks or learns for it.
out_of_scope: Keeping and recalling its history, choosing which part a request needs, deciding when to ask, learning from feedback and translating implied priorities.
milestones: 1. A representative carries its own identity and authority, never another's, with or without a person behind it (metric-the-representatives).
measures_of_success: A representative carries its own identity and authority, with or without a person behind it.
inputs: A representative id, and the person asking when there is one.
outputs: The representative's identity, authority, data scope and preferences for the request.
effects: Reads and writes nothing itself: it calls the entry points of the parts it uses.
usage_notes: `hubofhubs.run("the-representatives", "")` returns the representative's authority, data scope and preferences. In a person's words it is asked for as: answer or write as me, in my voice or my style, on my behalf, with my authority, the way I would say it; or speak as a named character.
